title: The Ending of Defilements
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 52.24 Linked Discourses 52.24
  • 2. Dutiyavagga 2. A Thousand

Āsavakkhayasutta The Ending of Defilements

“Imesañca panāhaṁ, āvuso, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā āsavānaṁ khayā anāsavaṁ cetovimuttiṁ paññāvimuttiṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti. “… And it’s because of developing and cultivating these four kinds of mindfulness meditation that I realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom. And I live having realized it with my own insight in this very life due to the ending of defilements.”

Cuddasamaṁ.

Dutiyo vaggo.

Tassuddānaṁ

Mahābhiññaṁ iddhi dibbaṁ, Cetopariyaṁ ṭhānaṁ kammaṁ; Sabbatthadhātudhimutti, Indriyaṁ jhānaṁ tisso vijjāti.

Anuruddhasaṁyuttaṁ aṭṭhamaṁ. The Linked Discourses with Anuruddha, the eighth section.
